scope: One internal bill-amount correction. Source file is retained; current views are derived in memory. This is not a supplier tax-invoice alteration or authenticated production audit log.

evidence.description: Imaginary slip showing INR 250; the original example entry transcribed INR 200.

requests.reason: Fictional transcription error: 200 entered instead of 250.

reviews.reason: Demo owner accepts the correction against the fictional slip.

rules: Requests and rejections do not alter the current balance.
Owner approval changes the bill obligation, not the earlier cash payment.
The additional INR 50 is paid only through a separate settlement record.
The original record and proposed old/new values remain visible.
File hashes detect drift against the recorded reference but do not make local files tamper-proof.
One correction per bill is supported in this lesson; corrections to stock, wages, taxes and already overpaid bills need their own workflow.
